assertions.title: Project creation and listing works

steps.action: Open /sign-up and create a unique isolated account
steps.expected: Signup succeeds and redirects into an authenticated dashboard session
steps.observed: The UI stayed on /sign-up and rendered an inline grain activation failure: auth grain activate: node runtime dependency "janus-node-runtime" not found in injected dependencies.

steps.action: Open /get-started, switch to the Projects workspace, and inspect the empty list state
steps.expected: The New Project form renders and the empty state is only a pre-submit starting point for an authenticated user
steps.observed: The Projects panel rendered with 'Signed out', '0 total', and 'No projects yet.' while no authenticated session existed.

steps.action: Fill the New Project form and submit it
steps.expected: A project is created and appears in the Projects list, enabling the Use Across Workflows propagation path
steps.observed: Submitting the populated form surfaced an inline 'unauthorized' message, and the list remained empty.

evidence.consoleErrors: Repeated browser errors after dashboard loads: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 401 (Unauthorized); no separate JavaScript exception stack traces were observed.
evidence.network: POST /api/v1/auth/signup -> 202 with pollUrl /api/v1/operations/op_b8c8c67db836edbf008e8e24; GET /api/v1/operations/op_b8c8c67db836edbf008e8e24 -> 200 {status: failed, failure.code: service_unavailable, failure.message includes missing janus-node-runtime dependency}; POST /api/v1/projects -> 401 unauthorized; GET /api/v1/projects -> 401 unauthorized.

assertions.issues: Blocked by a broken authentication prerequisite: isolated signup fails, leaving the dashboard signed out so project CRUD cannot be exercised.

assertions.title: Repository import triggers a build

steps.action: Switch to the Pipeline workspace and inspect Repo Import
steps.expected: An authenticated project can be selected before importing a repository
steps.observed: The Project selector only exposed 'Select project' because no authenticated project context existed.

steps.action: Enter a valid public repository URL and branch
steps.expected: The Import Repository action can be submitted and produce a build result card
steps.observed: The repo URL field accepted https://github.com/fermyon/http-rust-template and branch main, but Import Repository remained disabled because no project could be selected.

steps.action: Use the same browser session to confirm project access
steps.expected: The project list is available for repo import prerequisites
steps.observed: The authenticated prerequisite was still missing and the projects endpoint returned 401 unauthorized.

evidence.consoleErrors: Repeated browser errors after dashboard loads: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 401 (Unauthorized); no separate JavaScript exception stack traces were observed.
evidence.network: GET /api/v1/projects -> 401 unauthorized. No POST /api/v1/repos/import request was emitted from the UI because the repo import form stayed disabled without a selectable project.

assertions.issues: Blocked upstream by failed account creation and the resulting inability to create/select a project for repo import.

assertions.title: File uploads work for source bundles and WASM artifacts

steps.action: Search the repository for reusable upload fixtures
steps.expected: A zip/tar.gz/tgz bundle and a .wasm artifact are already available
steps.observed: No suitable repo fixtures were present, so minimal local fixtures were created in the assigned mission evidence directory.

steps.action: Inspect the Direct Uploads panel in Pipeline view
steps.expected: Both forms can select a project, accept the local files, and submit multipart uploads
steps.observed: Both Project selectors only exposed 'Select project', so Upload Source Bundle and Upload WASM Artifact stayed disabled before any multipart request could be sent.

steps.action: Confirm the missing prerequisite in the same browser session
steps.expected: An authenticated project list is available to unlock uploads
steps.observed: Projects access remained unauthorized, so upload submission could not be reached.

evidence.consoleErrors: Repeated browser errors after dashboard loads: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 401 (Unauthorized); no separate JavaScript exception stack traces were observed.
evidence.network: GET /api/v1/projects -> 401 unauthorized. No POST /api/v1/uploads/source-bundles or POST /api/v1/uploads/artifacts request fired because both upload forms were blocked at project selection.

assertions.issues: Blocked because uploads require a project context, and authenticated project creation never became available.

assertions.title: Builds panel displays status, filtering, and log viewing

steps.action: Inspect the Build Status panel in Pipeline view
steps.expected: Build cards, project filtering, status chips, and View Logs actions are available once builds exist
steps.observed: The panel rendered the Project Filter and Refresh Builds controls but only showed 'Total: 0' and 'No builds yet.' with no build cards.

steps.action: Confirm build data access from the same browser session
steps.expected: The dashboard can retrieve build data for the signed-in user
steps.observed: The builds endpoint returned 401 unauthorized while the UI continued to present an empty state.

steps.action: Check for log entry points
steps.expected: At least one build row exposes View Logs once data is present
steps.observed: The DOM contained 0 View Logs buttons because no build rows rendered.

evidence.consoleErrors: Repeated browser errors after dashboard loads: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 401 (Unauthorized); no separate JavaScript exception stack traces were observed.
evidence.network: GET /api/v1/builds -> 401 unauthorized; DOM probe reported viewLogsButtons: 0.

assertions.issues: Blocked by missing authenticated build data; filtering and log-view entry points could not be exercised against real build rows.

steps.action: Inspect the deployments list state
steps.expected: Real deployment rows appear and can be filtered
steps.observed: The panel showed 'Total: 0' and 'No deployments yet.' in the signed-out session.

steps.action: Confirm deployment data access from the same browser session
steps.expected: The dashboard can retrieve deployment data for the signed-in user
steps.observed: The deployments endpoint returned 401 unauthorized.

evidence.consoleErrors: Repeated browser errors after dashboard loads: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 401 (Unauthorized); no separate JavaScript exception stack traces were observed.
evidence.network: GET /api/v1/deployments -> 401 unauthorized. No POST /api/v1/deployments request was emitted because the form never had a valid project/build selection.

assertions.issues: Blocked upstream by the missing authenticated project/build data needed to create and list deployments.

steps.action: Confirm domain data access from the same browser session

steps.observed: The domains endpoint returned 401 unauthorized.

evidence.consoleErrors: Repeated browser errors after dashboard loads: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 401 (Unauthorized); no separate JavaScript exception stack traces were observed.
evidence.network: GET /api/v1/domains -> 401 unauthorized; DOM probe reported endpointLinks: 0.

assertions.issues: Blocked because no authenticated deployments/domains could be created or listed.

steps.expected: At least one build or deployment row exposes a View Logs button that opens the log modal

frictions.description: The repository did not contain reusable upload fixtures for VAL-FH-016.
frictions.resolution: Created frontend-hardening/dashboard-panels-rerun/minimal-module.wasm (8-byte valid WASM header) and frontend-hardening/dashboard-panels-rerun/source-bundle.zip containing module.wasm under the assigned evidence directory.

frictions.description: The signed-out dashboard rendered empty-state panels while the underlying API calls were failing with 401 responses, which hid the auth blocker from the visible UI alone.
frictions.resolution: Confirmed the hidden failure mode with browser-side fetch probes for /api/v1/auth/me, /projects, /builds, /deployments, and /domains.

blockers.description: Isolated account creation is broken: auth signup operations fail with service_unavailable because the auth grain cannot activate without the injected janus-node-runtime dependency.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Retried the sign-up flow in the browser with a second unique email and also polled the returned operation directly from the same browser session; both attempts failed with the same missing janus-node-runtime dependency message.

blockers.description: Because the browser session remained signed out, dashboard data endpoints for projects, builds, deployments, and domains all returned 401 unauthorized, leaving downstream forms disabled and lists empty.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Confirmed GET /api/v1/auth/me, /projects, /builds, /deployments, and /domains from the same browser session; each returned 401 unauthorized while the UI continued to show signed-out empty states.

summary: Re-ran all 7 assigned dashboard panel assertions against the local source-built frontend on port 3000. All 7 remain blocked by a backend auth prerequisite: isolated signup fails with a missing janus-node-runtime dependency, and the signed-out dashboard then receives 401 responses for projects/builds/deployments/domains while rendering empty states instead of usable data.
